method: Train DenseNet feature head DIRECTLY against FER TRAIN labels, independently of the overconfident FusDenseNet logits. Frozen feature extractors. Combine calibrated baseline and direct-head probabilities, not class thresholds.
head: LayerNorm1024->128->7, dropout.5
selection: Validation accuracy AND disgust recall strictly improve; macro/disgustF1 no lower. Max .5accuracy+.3macroF1+.2disgustF1 across60epochs/3predeclared mixtures.
disclosure: Third exploratory recipe declared after failed residual-head validation, before ANY new test access. Highly reused validation, not fresh confirmatory evidence; all failed recipes kept.
early_stopping: Track unconstrained validation objective progress; never stop a learning new head solely because it has not crossed joint deployment floors yet. Eligibility still requires BOTH accuracy and disgust recall gains.
test: One final candidate across all completed recipes. No alternate test search.

pretrained_provenance.training_corpus: ImageNet1K; no FER expression supervision in this source
pretrained_provenance.code_licence: Torchvision BSD3Clause, preserved locally. ImageNet access/data rights are distinct; no ImageNet images downloaded or redistributed.
pretrained_provenance.native_reported_accuracy: 74.434% is ImageNet1K top1, NOT FER or project accuracy
pretrained_provenance.preprocessing: weights.transforms(crop_size=112,resize_size=128), grayscale replicatedRGB; CPU adaptation, not native224-pixel inference
